required_visual_features: A scientific line/scatter chart with current or current density on the x axis.
Voltage is represented on the left y axis.
Power density or power is represented on the right y axis.
The chart uses two y axes or otherwise clearly maps voltage and power to separate value scales.
The voltage and power curves are drawn in distinguishable colors, not just black lines told apart by marker shape or line style.
At least two visible line series; do not target an isolated single-series chart or a marker-only scatter chart.
negative_cues: a chart whose curves are not distinguishable by color (e.g. all-black curves told apart only by marker shape or line style) — not currently extractable
A categorical x axis uses categorical_line_chart instead. A single-series numeric chart is not a CMSL extraction target.
output_requirements: Set chart_family to dual_y_current_voltage_power or a close descriptive variant.
Return bottom, left, and right axis geometry and numeric tick labels when visible.
Return legend_items when series labels are visible.

For each legend item, set axis_binding_hint to left_y or right_y by matching the legend label's meaning (e.g. a voltage-like label) to the matching axis title. Leave axis_binding_hint null only when the voltage and power-density curves for the same condition are drawn in the exact same color and cannot be told apart from the legend alone.

required_visual_features: At least two visible, distinguishable scientific line series (lines may also have markers).
Numeric x-axis and numeric y-axis scales; one or two y axes are allowed.
Series can be distinguished by color; a same-condition voltage/power pair may share color in a C-V-P chart.
Do not classify a lone series, categorical x-axis chart, or marker-only scatter chart as this target.
negative_cues: only scattered markers without visible connecting lines
output_requirements: Set extraction_family and chart_family to cmsl_line_chart.
Set is_chart=true and is_extraction_target=true only when the CMSL requirements are met.
Set is_target_dual_y=false; this legacy flag is reserved for current_voltage_power_dual_y.
Return bottom, left, and right axis geometry when visible, with numeric ticks and axis titles.
Return legend items when visible and axis_binding_hint when it can be read.
Prefer current_voltage_power_dual_y for a qualifying current-voltage-power chart.

enabled_extraction_families.display_name: Line/scatter chart with a categorical (non-numeric) x axis
required_visual_features: A line or scatter chart (points connected by lines, or scattered markers) whose x axis positions are category labels — sample names, material names, conditions, or similar text — not numbers.
One or more distinguishable data series, told apart by curve/marker color.
negative_cues: A chart whose x axis is numeric (has a real numeric scale with tick values) — use single_axis_line_chart or one of the dual-y families instead
A bar chart — bars, not lines or connected markers, are not currently extractable
A pie or donut chart — not currently extractable
a chart whose data series are all the same color and distinguished only by marker shape or line style, not color — not currently extractable
output_requirements: This family is read directly by codex from the panel crop rather than traced pixel-by-pixel, since there is no numeric x axis to calibrate pixel positions against. axes/ticks geometry are not required — a reasonable panel_bbox_figure_px is enough. Still return legend_items when a legend is visible, since it helps identify the panel.
